Rashi on Keritot 16a:10:1.english: And the menstruating woman is prohibited [from engaging in intercourse] with him - As it is written (Leviticus 20:18): "And both of them shall be cut off from among their people."

Rashi on Keritot 16a:11:1.hebrew: על הקטנות - כמו על הקטנה, ומאי קטנות? דעלמא. כלומר, הבא על אחת מן הקטנות ביאות הרבה בנדתה יוכיח, שאינה מוזהרת עליו וחייב על כל ביאה וביאה:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:11:1.english: With minor girls - [This is] like [saying] "with a minor girl." And what [is the meaning of] "minor girls"? [Minor girls] in general. That is to say: one who engages in intercourse with one of the minor girls many times during her menstruation will prove [it], for she is not subject to a prohibition regarding him, and he is liable for each and every act of intercourse.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:13:1.hebrew: הבא על הבהמה יוכיח - שחייב על כל ביאה כדאמרן לעיל, טעמא שא"א לערב הביאות:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:13:1.english: One who copulates with an animal will prove - For he is liable for every act of intercourse, as we said above, the reason [being] that it is impossible to combine the acts of intercourse.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:13:2.hebrew: בהמה כשבת - פלוגתא היא בגמרא. איכא למאן דאמר: קבל ר"ע מר"א, והכי קאמר ליה: בהמה כשבת — מה בהמה חייב על כל אחת ואחת, אף שבת חייב על כל אחת, דאינו יודע להשיב כלום. ולמאן דאמר לא קיבלה מיניה, ה"ק ליה: אף בהמה מיבעי לי כשבת:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:13:2.english: The animal is like Shabbat - There is a dispute [about this] in the Gemara. There is [an authority] who says [that] Rabbi Akiva accepted [the argument] from Rabbi Eliezer, and this is what he is saying to him: "The animal is like Shabbat — just as [for] an animal one is liable for each and every [act], so too [for] Shabbat one is liable for each one," for he does not know [how] to respond at all. And according to the one who says he did not accept it from him, this is what he is saying to him: "Even [the case of] an animal is a question to me, like Shabbat."

Rashi on Keritot 16a:14:1.hebrew: מאי קבעי מיניה - דנקט שבתות הרבה, ועושה בזו אותה מלאכה שעשה בזו, ונקט תולדות ולא אבות:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:14:1.english: What dilemma did he raise before him - That he stated "many Shabbatot," and "performs on this [Shabbat] the same labor that he performed on that [Shabbat]," and he stated "subcategories [of labor]" and not "primary categories"?

Rashi on Keritot 16a:14:2.hebrew: אי קבעי מיניה שבתות כגופין דמיין אי לא - אי האי דעבד בכמה שבתות, אותן מלאכות שעשה בזו עשה בזו, ובהעלם אחד דלא הודע לו בינתיים, מי אמרינן: כיון דבתרי שבתות עשאן, הויין הני תרתי שבתות כשני גופי עבירות, כאילו קצר וזרע בהעלם אחת, וחייב על כל אחת; או לא, דאמרינן דהוי כעושה מלאכה אחת כמה פעמים בהעלם אחת, דחייב חדא? אי הא קמיבעיא ליה, אמאי נקט תולדות? ליבעי הכי: אעשה אב מלאכה אחת בשבתות הרבה, מהו:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:14:2.english: If he raised a dilemma before him [whether] Shabbatot are comparable to [separate] entities or not - [That is:] if one who performed [labors] on several Shabbatot — the same labors that he performed on this [Shabbat] he performed on that [Shabbat], and in a single lapse of awareness, such that it was not made known to him in between — do we say [that] since he performed them on two [different] Shabbatot, these two Shabbatot are like two [separate] categories of transgressions, as if he reaped and sowed in a single lapse of awareness, and he is liable for each one; or not, for we say that it is like one who performs a single labor several times in a single lapse of awareness, where he is liable [for only] one [sin-offering]? If this is what he was asking him, why did he mention subordinate labors [toladot]? Let him ask thus: [If] one performs one primary labor [av melakhah] on many Shabbatot, what is [the law]?

Rashi on Keritot 16a:15:1.hebrew: אי בולדי מלאכות קבעי מיניה - אם עושה תולדות הרבה מאב אחד, אי חייב אחת או על כל אחת ואחת, ולהכי נקט תולדות — אם כן, אמאי נקט שבתות הרבה? ליבעי הכי: העושה מלאכות הרבה מעין מלאכה אחת בשבת אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:15:1.english: If he is asking about subcategories of labors - [Meaning,] if one performs many subcategories of one primary labor, whether he is liable [for] one [sin-offering] or for each and every one, and for that reason he mentioned subcategories — if so, why did he mention many Shabbatot? Let him ask thus: "One who performs many labors resembling one labor on one Shabbat."

Rashi on Keritot 16a:16:1.hebrew: תרתי בעא מיניה - ופשיט תרוייהו לחומרא, מדקתני חייב על כל אחת ואחת, ואע"ג דמנדה לא מצי למיפשט ליה אלא חדא, דהא בנדה ליכא תולדות:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:16:1.english: He raised two dilemmas before him - And he [Rabbi Eliezer] resolved both of them stringently, from that which it teaches: "he is liable for each and every one," and even though from [the case of] a menstruating woman [niddah] he could only resolve one [dilemma] for him, since in [the case of] niddah there are no subcategories [toladot].

Rashi on Keritot 16a:17:1.hebrew: ושבתות היכא - איזו מהן? כלומר, ה"ד דקעביד לה להא (אב) מלאכה בכמה שבתות? בשגגת שבתות וזדון מלאכות, פשיטא ליה לר"ע דחייב על כל אחת, דלא אמרינן חדא שגגה, אלא אמרינן ימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה, דדמי כמי שנודע לו בינתיים דשבת הוי, והוי כעושה מלאכה אחת בכמה העלמות:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:17:1.english: And [regarding] Shabbatot, where - Which of them? That is to say, what is the case in which he performs this (primary) labor on several Shabbatot? [If it was] with unwittingness as to Shabbatot and intentionality as to labors, it is obvious to Rabbi Akiva that he is liable for each one, for we do not say [that it is] one unwitting act; rather, we say [that the] intervening days constitute awareness, for it is comparable to one who became aware in the meantime that it was Shabbat, and he is like one who performs one labor in several lapses of awareness.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:18:1.hebrew: וזדון שבת - יודע שהוא שבת, ושגגת מלאכות — דסבור שמלאכה זו מותרת — היא דבעי מיניה. דהא ליכא למימר ימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה לחלק — דלהכי הויין ידיעה, לידע ששבת היתה, אבל לענין שגגת מלאכות ליכא ידיעה עד שילמוד. והכי קמיבעיא ליה: האי דעבד חדא מלאכה בב' שבתות, מי אמרינן כיון דבב' ימים הם, אף על גב דהעלם אחד הוא לגבי מלאכות, הויין הנך שבתות כגופין של מלאכה שאינן דומין זה לזה, כגון זרע וקצר בהעלם אחד בזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, דחייב על כל אחת, כדאמרינן שבת (דף ע.): "אחת שהיא הנה — זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות":
Rashi on Keritot 16a:18:1.english: And intentionality [with regard to] Shabbat - [That is, he] knows that it is Shabbat, and unwittingness [with regard to] labors — that he thinks this labor is permitted — is what he asks him about. For one cannot say [that] the intervening days constitute an awareness to separate [the acts into multiple liabilities], since [it is only] for that [aspect] that they constitute an awareness — to know that it was Shabbat — whereas regarding unwittingness of labors, there is no awareness until he learns [that it is forbidden]. And this is what he is asking: [In the case of] this [person] who performed one labor on two Shabbatot, do we say [that] since they are on two [separate] days, even though it is one [period of] unawareness with respect to labors, those Shabbatot are like [distinct] entities of labor that are not similar to one another — such as [one who] sowed and reaped in one [period of] unawareness with intentionality [regarding] Shabbat and unwittingness [regarding] labors, where he is liable for each one, as we say [in tractate] Shabbat (70a): "One [case] that is many — intentionality [regarding] Shabbat and unwittingness [regarding] labors"?

Rashi on Keritot 16a:18:2.hebrew: או לאו - כגופין דמיין, והרי עשה בהעלם אחד מלאכה אחת י' פעמים, שאינו חייב אלא אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:18:2.english: Or not - [i.e., they are not] like [separate] bodies, and behold, he performed one labor ten times in a single lapse of awareness, so that he is liable for only one [sin offering].

Rashi on Keritot 16a:19:1.hebrew: או דלמא זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות פשיטא ליה דשבתות - כגופי מלאכות שאין דומות זו לזו, שהעושן בשגגת מלאכות וזדון שבת חייב שתים, דהיינו "אחת שהיא הנה". ובשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות קמבעיא ליה, דאפילו אמרי' כגופין דמיין לא מחייב אלא חדא, דהיינו "הנה שהיא אחד", שהעושה ב' אבות בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות בהעלם אחד אינו חייב אלא אחת, אלא אי איכא ידיעה בינתיים דשבת היא, מהניא לחלק, דהעלמות מחלקין. והכי קמיבעיא ליה: מי אמרינן ימים שבנתיים הויין ידיעה כמו שנודע לו ששבת היא, אי לא:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:19:1.english: Or perhaps [in the case of] intentionality [regarding] Shabbat and unwittingness [regarding] labors, it is obvious to him that Shabbatot - [are] like [distinct] bodies of labors that are not similar to one another, for one who performs them with unwittingness of labors and intentionality of Shabbat is liable [for] two [sin offerings], which is [the case of] "one that is many [henah]." And [it is] regarding unwittingness of Shabbat and intentionality of labors [that] he raises his dilemma, for even if we say they are like [separate] entities, he is only liable [for] one, which is [the case of] "many [henah] that is one," for one who performs two primary categories of labor with unwittingness of Shabbat and intentionality of labors in a single lapse of awareness is only liable [for] one [sin offering]; rather, if there is awareness in between that it is Shabbat, it is effective to differentiate, for [separate] lapses of awareness differentiate. And this is what he is asking: Do we say [that] the intervening days are [considered] awareness, just as if it became known to him that it was Shabbat, or not?

Rashi on Keritot 16a:1:1.english: And yet, regarding uncertainties, etc., it does not teach - In the last clause, regarding misuse [of consecrated property].

Rashi on Keritot 16a:1:2.english: Whose [opinion is this] - That is to say, who is the first Tanna?

Rashi on Keritot 16a:1:3.hebrew: ר"ע מחייב על ספק מעילה כו' - בפרק דם שחיטה (לקמן כריתות כב.):
Rashi on Keritot 16a:1:3.english: Rabbi Akiva deems [one] liable for uncertainty [about] misuse [of consecrated property], etc. - In the chapter [entitled] Dam Shechitah (below, Keritot 22a).

Rashi on Keritot 16a:2:1.hebrew: וקתני בה' העלמות כו' - העלמות הוא דמחלקין, אבל זבחים לא, וש"מ הדר ביה ר' יהושע:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:2:1.english: And it teaches: During five lapses of awareness, etc. - [It is] lapses of awareness that separate [them into distinct liabilities], but offerings do not; and conclude from this [that] Rabbi Yehoshua retracted [his view].

Rashi on Keritot 16a:4:1.hebrew: אלא מאי אית לך למימר - מיהא ברייתא תנאי היא, בתמיה. כלומר, מאי בעית למשמע מהך ברייתא? תנאי היא — ת"ק דקתני העלמות, דמשמע דהעלמות מחלקין ולא זבחים, אית ליה דקיבלה ר' יהושע והדר ביה, והאי דקתני ה' זבחים בהעלם אחד חייב על כל אחד ואחד, תנא אחרינא הוא ואית ליה דלא קיבלה? אפילו הא לא פשטת מינה דתנאי היא, דאפילו תימא ר' עקיבא היא, ות"ק אליבא דר"ע קאי, מדקתני העלמות, דמשמע העלמות ולא זבחים. ודקא קשיא לך דלא תניא אשם תלוי אספק מעילות:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:4:1.english: Rather, what do you have to say - From this baraita, [that] it is [a dispute of] Tannaim? [This is said] as a rhetorical question. That is to say, what do you want to infer from this baraita? [That] it is [a dispute of] Tannaim — [namely, that] the Tanna Kamma, who teaches "lapses of awareness," which implies that lapses of awareness divide [liability] and not offerings, holds that Rabbi Yehoshua accepted [Rabbi Akiva's refutation] and retracted; and this [clause] that teaches "[if he ate from] five offerings in one lapse of awareness, he is liable for each and every one," is another Tanna who holds that he did not accept it? Even this you cannot resolve from it, that it is [such a dispute of] Tannaim, for you can even say [the first clause] is Rabbi Akiva, and the Tanna Kamma stands in accordance with Rabbi Akiva, since he teaches "lapses of awareness," which implies lapses of awareness [divide liability] and not offerings. And as for what was difficult for you, that it does not teach a provisional guilt offering for doubtful misuse of consecrated property:

Rashi on Keritot 16a:5:1.hebrew: האי תנא סבר לה כו' - והאי דקתני מה' זבחים בהעלם אחד חייב על כל אחד, תנא אחרינא הוא ור' יהושע היא:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:5:1.english: This tanna holds in accordance with [him], etc. - And that which [the baraita] teaches, "[If one ate] from five sacrifices in one lapse of awareness, he is liable for each one," is a different tanna, and it is [the opinion of] Rabbi Yehoshua.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:6:1.hebrew: ה' דברים בעולה מצטרפין - לענין כזית להעלותן בחוץ, שאם העלן חייב כרת. ולהכי נקט עולה, דבשאר זבחים לא מצטרף בשר, לפי שאינן כליל. כאותה ששנינו כו', ה"נ שאכל מה' דברים הללו:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:6:1.english: Five items from a burnt offering combine - With regard to [forming] an olive-bulk for offering them up outside [the Temple], for if one offered them up he is liable to karet. And this is why [the Mishnah] specified a burnt offering: because with other sacrifices, the meat does not combine, since they are not wholly burned [on the altar]. "Like that which we learned, etc." — here too, [the case is] where he ate from these five items.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:7:1.hebrew: בכתף - יש ה' אברים: הפרסה, והעצם התחתון עד הארכובה, ושני עצמות לבד מן הכתף:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:7:1.english: In the shoulder - There are five limbs [i.e., sections]: the hoof, and the lower bone up to the knee, and two bones besides the shoulder [itself].

Rashi on Keritot 16a:7:2.hebrew: ה' מיני קדירה - כגון כרישין ובצלים וכרוב ודלעת ולפת, ואכלן כזה עצמו וכזה עצמו:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:7:2.english: Five types of cooked dishes - Such as leeks, onions, cabbage, gourd, and turnip, and he ate them [cooked] with this by itself and with that by itself.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:7:3.hebrew: ה' מיני טעמים - צלי, ומבושל, כבוש, שלוק, וצלי קדר:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:7:3.english: Five types of flavors - Roasted, boiled, pickled, overcooked, and pot-roasted.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:8:1.hebrew: מלאכות הרבה מעין מלאכה אחת - תולדות הרבה של אב אחד בשבתות הרבה, אותן שעשה בשבת זו עשה בשבתות אחריני, וכולן בהעלם אחת. ובגמרא פריך: מאי קמבעיא ליה דנקט תרי מילי — שבתות הרבה ותולדות הרבה — ואמאי נקט תולדות ולא אבות:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:8:1.english: Multiple labors subsumed under one [category of] labor - Multiple subcategories of one primary [category of] labor, on multiple Shabbatot — those [labors] that he performed on this Shabbat, he performed on other Shabbatot — and all of them [were performed] during one lapse of awareness. And in the Gemara it asks: What is his dilemma, that he stated two matters — multiple Shabbatot and multiple subcategories — and why did he state subcategories and not primary [categories of] labor?

Rashi on Keritot 16a:9:1.hebrew: תוצאות הרבה - עניינים הרבה, כגון שבת דאיכא אבות מלאכות ותולדותיהן:
Rashi on Keritot 16a:9:1.english: Multiple outcomes - Multiple matters, such as Shabbat, where there are primary categories of labor and their subcategories.

Rashi on Keritot 16a:9:2.hebrew: נדה אין בה תוצאות הרבה - דאין חיובה אלא ביאה, וחייב על כל ביאה וביאה בהעלם אחת, כדאמר ר"א לעיל בגמרא: בא עליה וחזר ובא עליה כו':
Rashi on Keritot 16a:9:2.english: A menstruating woman, [with regard to whom] there are not multiple [actions that] result [in transgression] - For its liability is only [for] intercourse, yet one is liable for each and every act of intercourse in a single lapse of awareness, as Rabbi Eliezer said above in the Gemara: "[If] one engaged in intercourse with her and again engaged in intercourse with her," etc.

Tosafot on Keritot 16a:2:1.hebrew: אלא לאו רבי יהושע היא וקתני בה' העלמות חייב ה' חטאות - משום דוקא העלמות מחלקין. ופר"י דה"ה דמצי לאתויי מרישא: "ה' חתיכות מה' תמחויין מזבח אחד אינו חייב אלא אחת", דהא במתני' נמי מדמי תמחויין; אלא משום דתמחויין לא הוה הבעיא, לא נקט ליה:
Tosafot on Keritot 16a:2:1.english: Rather, isn’t it [the opinion of] Rabbi Yehoshua, and it teaches: "During five lapses of awareness, he is liable for five sin offerings" - [This proves that Rabbi Yehoshua accepted Rabbi Akiva's view,] because [it implies that] specifically lapses of awareness separate [the offerings into multiple liabilities]. And Rabbeinu Yitzchak (Ri) explained that similarly, [the Gemara] could have brought [its proof] from the first clause [of the baraita]: "Five pieces from five pots from a single offering — he is liable for only one," for in the Mishnah as well they compare [the case of five] pots [to this]; however, because [the case of five] pots was not the subject of the dilemma, [the Gemara] did not cite it.

Tosafot on Keritot 16a:5:1.hebrew: אפילו תימא ר"ע היא - וה' זבחים בהעלם אחת חייב על כל אחת ואחת — לאו ר"ע, אלא ר' יהושע:
Tosafot on Keritot 16a:5:1.english: You may even say it is Rabbi Akiva - And [the clause of] five offerings in a single lapse of awareness, [where] he is liable for each and every one — [that is] not Rabbi Akiva, rather Rabbi Yehoshua.

Tosafot on Keritot 16a:7:1.hebrew: בכתף של עולה - יש בה ז' עצמות:
Tosafot on Keritot 16a:7:1.english: In the shoulder of a burnt offering - There are seven bones in it:

Tosafot on Keritot 16a:7:2.hebrew: בה' מיני קדירה - פר"י: כגון צלי, ומבושל, וטיגון, וצלי קדר, וכבוש; וה' מיני טעמים — כגון פילפלין, וזנגבילא, וקנה, וקנמון, וקדה. ורש"י לא פירש כן:
Tosafot on Keritot 16a:7:2.english: As five types of cooked dishes - The Ri explained: For example, roasted, boiled, fried, pot-roasted, and pickled; and five types of flavors — for example, pepper, ginger, sweet cane, cinnamon, and cassia. And Rashi did not explain [it] this way.
